_: Named looks for tascene-view.html. `?preset=<name>` expands to that query string; anything you also spell out in the URL wins over the preset. A preset may not name another preset. Staged into the pack next to the viewer by `tascene serve` / `tascene shot`, so it is a checked-in lab file and never pack content.

classic.about: Classic: what tagpu draws today — the flat 32-px grid, the base atlases (every palette index expanded to its colour, alpha 0 at a frame's key), the face-shade multiplier on units. The only look that carries a parity claim; this is the side to put a new one against. `engine` is the same look under its older name.

classicpp.about: Classic++: the lab renderer at its defaults — restored colour (needs a pack built with --undither; indexed otherwise), a level-normalised per-pixel sun, trilinear textures, cast shadows under the engine's three suns.

engine.about: The older name of `classic`, kept because notes and scripts spell it: a=engine&b=… still works.

slope.about: The painted art, not displaced, lit by the map's real gradient. The control for the double-count question: geometry unchanged, lighting added, so anything that goes wrong here is the light alone.

relief.about: The heightfield displaced by the engine's own h/2, unlit. Isolates the geometry: whatever looks wrong here is the shape.

relief-sun.about: Displaced AND lit — where the art's baked-in shading double-counts. Wipe it against `slope` to see by how much.

restored.about: The undithered atlases and nothing else changed. Needs a pack built with `--undither`.

restored-relief.about: Everything the exploration lane has: restored colour, real relief, a real sun. Needs a pack built with `--undither`.

half-relief.about: Half the engine's displacement. If the double-count is the problem, the answer is somewhere on this axis and this is the middle of it.

orders-engine.about: Classic with the engine's order markers as the engine would draw them into a zoomed world: the cursors.gaf art scaled with the zoom, a dot every 48 world units. Exact at zoom 1; specks at 0.25x, blocks at 4x.

orders-proc.about: Classic with the order markers tagpu draws today (tagpu_order.c): a 2.4-px disc per route dot and a breathing crosshair, in the art's ink. Wipe it against orders-tuned.

orders-tuned.about: The engine's order art made to read the same at every zoom: drawn at its own size, one texel a pixel, with the dots 48 px apart on screen and moving 48 px a second, so a zoom changes neither the size, the spacing nor the speed of the line. At zoom 1 it is the engine's picture.
